source_audit.reviewer: benchmark curator model, complete source/diff review
source_audit.notes: Complete source reviewed. Original BF16/FP32 weights retained; optional 12-bit grouping is lossless bit reconstruction with original-weight fallback for unrepresentable groups. Router hi/lo split is explicitly permitted. Kernel configurations are selected in prepare using bounded synthetic, data-independent activations and private CUDA events, without patching the evaluator or its timing. Timed kernels read every current activation and preserve output dtypes. Compilation and all-shape correctness still require full evaluation.

scope: Full public-shape, fresh-seed local benchmark; not an official OKC score.
